reason: The model controls only for firm size and age. It leaves out productivity_2020 and the other 2020 pre-period covariates (R&D, exports, credit score, ownership, union share, sector, region), which plausibly drive both training and later productivity, so the 0.627 coefficient is not credibly causal. The 1% outcome trimming is also an unjustified sample choice. I could not re-run the robustness checks because Bash was denied.
